Search [[the Mirror of Lyss]] for survivors of [[Nightfall (event)|Nightfall]], and save them from the invading [[Margonite]]s.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Find [[Prince Ahmtur the Mighty|Ahmtur the Mighty]] and the other soldiers in the Mirror of Lyss.
* Search for and rescue Nightfall survivors in the ruins of the Mirror of Lyss and the surrounding area. [3...0] of 3 survivor groups remain.
* Escort [[Priest Tuwahan]] to the safety of [[the Kodash Bazaar]].
* Shuttle the family to the protection of the Kodash Bazaar.
* Help the students reach the refuge of the Kodash Bazaar.
* See Lieutenant Murunda for your reward.

===Reward===
* 2,000 [[Experience]]
* 250 [[Gold]]
* 10 [[Lightbringer Points]]

===Environmental changes===
* These do not [[spawn]] if this quest is active:
** The [[merchant]] [[Ahjii]]
** The bosses [[Shezel Slowreaper]] and [[Yammiron, Ether Lord]]
** [[Roaring Ether]]s and [[Ruby Djinn]]s, which makes vanquishing easier since they are difficult to kill.

==Walkthrough==
Start from [[Dzagonur Bastion]], and meet Prince Ahmtur and his guards just outside in the Mirror of Lyss. After speaking to Prince Ahmtur, a Vabbi Guard Captain and 4 [[Vabbi Guard]]s will join your party to assist in the search for survivors. Do '''not''' map travel to the Grand Court of Sebelkeh, if so, the quest will not complete properly.

From here, it is a case of following the quest pointer to each of the 3 groups, and defeating any hostile groups encountered along the way.  Note that the groups can be saved in any order, not necessarily the order listed in the objectives.

Survivors can be blocked by NPCs such as [[spirit]]s, so ensure the survivors continue to follow or you may need to backtrack to collect them.

At each survivor group, there will be 3-4 [[Margonite]] groups patrolling nearby, so careful [[pull]]ing of each group is required.

On arrival at the Kodash Bazaar, walk up to the entrance, but do not walk in (or leave the area) until the quest updates, otherwise the quest will not complete properly. The quest updates when Talgun, Priest Tuwahan, and Belanu reach the final quest pointer.

'''Prince Ahmtur''' is searching for survivors in the Mirror of Lyss with a small contingent of soldiers. I'm worried about him, but I know he'd be furious if I chased him down. I don't know what I...what WE would do without him. Would you '''find''' him?"''

==Notes==
{{anomaly|The final dialogue with the family ([[Belanu]], [[Charmah]], and [[Kimab]]) doesn't always trigger. Try to have them arrive at the location at the same time to make it trigger.}}
* The amount of [[chest]]s is reduced while this quest is active.
* The survivor groups follow the party around, but do not join as allies, so they are not attacked by hostile groups (except for any accidental [[area of effect|AoE]] effects targeted on the party members).
** The survivor groups move slowly and so care should be taken that they do not get stuck on any objects - all of the survivors are required to complete the quest.
* It isn't necessary to use the Vabbi Guards, so you may start from Kodash Bazaar if you wish (i.e. you could clear the quest path of foes before talking to Ahmtur the Mighty).
* Since the guards follow the party but not your commands, they may need to be ''led'' towards any hostile groups that you are attacking. This can be a problem for solo (with henchmen) players who use ranged attacks and skills, since you may have to move into close [[aggro]] range to ensure the guards start to attack.
* Priest Tuwahan from this quest is quite close to Hanbahd from [[The Madness of Prophecy]] quest, and since you will have 5 guard NPCs to assist you, that quest can also be completed very easily while doing this one.
* If you die and resurrect via a shrine, the survivors you have gathered will rejoin your party by running towards you from your previous point of death.
